Navigate to the Payment Gateway object. 2. Select the "View All" option. 3. Click the Payment Gateway record you want to sync. 4. Click the **Sync with Stripe** button. 5. Select either the Core, Billing, or Connect tab. ![G_04 historical sync pic 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_04%20historical%20sync%20pic%201.png){height="" width=""} 7. In the {{variable.Field_PG_SyncStripe_From}} and {{variable.Field_PG_SyncStripe_To}} fields, choose a date/time range for the data sync, if applicable. ![G_04 historical sync pic 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_04%20historical%20sync%20pic%202.png){height="" width=""} 9. Click the **Payment Methods** button. ![Historical Sync Stripe Payment Methods](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Historical%20Sync%20Stripe%20Payment%20Methods.png){height="" width=""} 11. A message will appear telling you that the process has started. {{snippet.PT_HistSync_Stripe_Suggestion}}
